description: This file contains the implementation of the InlineLoanCOBExecutorServiceImpl class, which manages the execution of batch jobs for processing loans' Close Of Business (COB) activities within the Apache Fineract platform. It handles loan ID validation, locking, scheduling batch jobs, and processing loan data related to COB dates.

classes.name: InlineLoanCOBExecutorServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class responsible for executing COB-related batch jobs for loans, including scheduling, locking, and processing loan data based on COB dates.

methods.name: executeInlineJob
methods.description: Public method to parse loan IDs from JSON command and trigger the COB processing job asynchronously.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main logic to process a list of loan IDs over a range of COB business dates, scheduling jobs for each day.

methods.name: getLoanIdsToBeProcessed
methods.description: Filters loan IDs to determine which are behind the given COB business date.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Triggers the execution of a specific batch job for a set of loan IDs on a designated business date, including locking accounts and handling job scheduling.

methods.name: getOldestCOBBusinessDate
methods.description: Determines the earliest COB business date from a list of loans.

methods.name: getLoansToBeProcessed
methods.description: Retrieves loan IDs with last closed business dates before a specified COB date.

methods.name: getLoanAccountLocks
methods.description: Resolves existing locks on loan accounts or creates new locks, throwing exceptions if locked and un-overridable.

methods.name: getJobParametersMap
methods.description: Creates a map of job parameters, including JSON-encoded loan IDs and COB business date, and stores them as custom job parameters.

methods.name: lockLoanAccounts
methods.description: Locks loan accounts by creating or updating LoanAccountLock entries within a new transaction.

methods.name: isLockOverrulable
methods.description: Determines whether an existing loan lock can be overruled based on user context.

methods.name: isBypassUser
methods.description: Checks whether the current authenticated user has bypass permissions.

methods.name: validateLoanIdsListSize
methods.description: Validates that the list of loan IDs does not exceed the configured size limit for COB processing requests.
